external_primary_crosschecks.note: Abstract corroborates finite-sample supervised domain adaptation with invariant candidate predictors, target-only no-negative-transfer behavior under sufficient margins, and matching lower bounds when margins are too small.

Primary abstract corroborates 30-42% false and 10-33% harmful greedy edits, 13-21 spurious modifications in no-gain runs, 4.9-point degradation in the fragile cell, and ~18% lower evaluation cost for PACE.

Primary abstract corroborates deterministic proposal/credit separation and sealed-test credited gains of +9 to +15.5pp with 86-147% train-lift retention; neutral-mechanism ~60% false-credit detail remains sourced from the sealed worker's primary reading.
Primary abstract corroborates seven paired blocks, 48 jobs per policy, QD -0.135% vs Sequential and +0.320% vs Independent Root with intervals crossing zero, plus stepping-stone ancestry engagement.
Primary abstract corroborates +60.6pp versus fixed five-round repair and 0.72 average repairs in GSM8K stress, plus verifier-discrimination/sign-identifiability framing.
Primary abstract corroborates chronology-audit 82/240 to 88/240, p=0.2632, CI [-1.25,+6.25], exploratory 467-pair +4.50pp set, and explicit non-confirmatory scope.
Primary abstract corroborates 262/270 endpoint success, 55/270 authorized completions, and 207 invalidating rows committing after authority failure, with all clean controls authorized.

Primary abstract corroborates 25 configurations x 525 tasks/25 episodes, 16.0% to 35.3% carryover ASR after three malicious tasks, and SafeEvolve aggregate reductions with +0.4-point mean benign utility change.

Peer-reviewed workshop PDF directly corroborates HM-Max+Sem 95.91->37.00 at iteration 1 and 31.76 at iteration 10, and Table VI HM-Bal +62.7 benign with -4.1/-6.0/-10.2/-10.2 malicious-subclass deltas.
Primary abstract corroborates 95.08% MiniF2F and 41.4% ProofNet for the system; worker's no-compute-matched-planner caveat is retained.
Primary abstract corroborates 87% MiniF2F, 57% PutnamBench and 49% Seed-Prover proof compression and faster Lean checking/downstream reuse.

Primary HTML directly corroborates representative temporal ablation: Full System 34.7% Any Medal vs w/o efficient coding workflow/full-dataset debugging 24.0%, and explicitly says the temporal ablation combines one representative primary run.

Primary abstract corroborates 700K field/time-matched citation preference training, future-year/unseen-field/review generalization, and higher-potential-impact proposal generation; exact worker percentages were not independently re-extracted in this pass.

assessments.rationale: Primary paper-level monitor signal remains relevant, but the current public evidence still does not expose numeric kappa_h or a runnable alarm/reset/refractory implementation. The sealed artifact correctly treats the end-to-end detector-to-policy path as unreproduced.
assessments.tested_scope: LargeMonitor representation/monitor signal in its tested online task-free continual-learning settings.
corrections_or_limits: Do not claim exact CUSUM alarm reproduction or closed-loop policy behavior from the public artifact.
No independent numerical replication upgrade.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed method plus pinned public code exposes exact same-label blur/domain-shift benchmark construction and concrete run parameters. The source-level wrapper defect is directly inspectable, while the standard experiment is independent-window classification rather than a chronological change-point trace.
assessments.tested_scope: Released DriftLens same-label visual distribution-shift scoring/window-classification experiments, especially STL-10 blur use case 8 and FairFace same-label domain shift.
corrections_or_limits: Do not interpret window accuracy as episode recall/FAR/detection delay.
Wrapper missing --run_driftlens is reproduction friction, not evidence against the method.
No independent numerical rerun identified.

assessments.rationale: Primary finite-sample theory supplies an explicit target-only fallback/no-negative-transfer envelope, favorable-margin rate improvement and matching lower bounds. This is unusually strong structural evidence for target-certified transfer, although exact real-experiment cells and executable artifact support were not recovered in this wave.
assessments.tested_scope: Bounded linear regression with stated covariance/conditioning assumptions, finite invariant-candidate dictionary, labeled target data and theorem-specified confidence conditions.
corrections_or_limits: Experimental heuristic confidence constants are not theorem-certified.
Do not generalize the target-only envelope to arbitrary nonlinear/online transfer.
No independent replication or source-code audit in this wave.

assessments.rationale: The candidate is a mathematically explicit composition of exact matched-pair/McNemar conditioning with Bernoulli conditional e-values. Under the stated per-task conditional discordant-sign null the product factor has conditional expectation <=1, giving optional-stopping validity.
assessments.tested_scope: One finalized paired binary outcome per independent outer task under the stronger conditional no-better/symmetry null.
corrections_or_limits: This is a derived application, not a published agent benchmark result.
Does not cover an average-only weak null or correlated rollouts treated as independent pairs.
Power at 10-50 tasks remains uncharacterized.

assessments.rationale: Blockwise e-value composition supports arbitrary internal dependence only after a task is collapsed to one valid finalized pair. The key evidence is therefore an estimand/symmetry gate, not a claim that within-task adaptive stopping is harmless.
assessments.tested_scope: Frozen symmetric task-finalization policies whose induced final paired outcome satisfies the outer null.
corrections_or_limits: Asymmetric/model-specific stopping can change the estimand.
Concrete agent-policy counterexamples and power studies remain open.

assessments.rationale: The 2026 induced-sequential-test theorem supports preserving a valid terminal test at a planned horizon, making exact McNemar a plausible finite-horizon endpoint without terminal power loss in principle.
assessments.tested_scope: Known maximum horizon with a valid terminal matched-pair test and safely computable null-conditional rejection probabilities.
corrections_or_limits: A computationally explicit exact-McNemar recursion was not derived here.
Naive Monte Carlo approximation is not automatically valid.

assessments.rationale: In the conditional McNemar e-process concordant tasks contribute factor one, so discordance count/rate is genuinely the information-resolution variable. The KL-based expected-log-growth numbers are useful sanity checks but not power guarantees.
assessments.tested_scope: Stable conditional win probability and discordance-rate approximation for the stated paired-binary process.
corrections_or_limits: Expected growth is not a stopping-time distribution.
Mixtures, heterogeneity and sparse discordance need simulation/exact analysis.

assessments.rationale: Public LinuxArena artifacts hold the environment and monitor threshold fixed while a stronger lane selected on other families raises uncaught ASR on one held-out family; the LOFO summary preserves the same qualitative direction. This is direct attacker-pressure sensitivity evidence but is sample-limited.
assessments.tested_scope: One LinuxArena clinical_trial environment, three small families, fixed threshold 10 and the committed Adapto evaluation bundles.
corrections_or_limits: Held-out family eval n=5; LOFO CI includes zero at the lower bound.
Do not infer a universal attacker ordering or general monitor failure.

assessments.rationale: Committed Adapto result bundles disagree on whether threshold 9 eliminates uncaught attacks across families. The discrepancy is directly inspectable and materially blocks a blanket mitigation claim until bundle-generation semantics are reconstructed.
assessments.tested_scope: The exact final_confirmation versus LOFO/fixed-fallback artifacts in the public Adapto repository.
corrections_or_limits: This is a cross-artifact scope/provenance defect, not evidence that threshold lowering never works.
Honest-task FPR provenance remains unresolved.

assessments.rationale: Peer-reviewed LAST-X evidence directly shows hard-negative mining is far more evasive than simple generation/fuzzing against the fixed ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 detector, with HM-Max+Sem dropping accuracy from 95.91% to 37.00% after one iteration and 31.76% by iteration 10.
assessments.tested_scope: HASTE in-loop test partition, one ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 detector architecture and the paper's synthetic attack/judge pipeline.
corrections_or_limits: Do not generalize potency to other detectors; the paper itself calls for multi-architecture evaluation.
No independent replication identified.

assessments.rationale: HASTE Table VI gives a matched shifted-fuzzing category breakdown where HM-Bal variants improve benign accuracy by +62.7 pp while several malicious subclasses regress by 4.1-10.2 pp, directly demonstrating aggregate/subclass trade-offs.
assessments.tested_scope: The HASTE ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 retraining pipeline under the All-type fuzzing out-of-loop condition.
corrections_or_limits: Category regression is configuration/taxonomy specific, not a general result that hardening is harmful.
Aggregate H-accuracy remains high, so this is a scope correction rather than overall failure.

assessments.rationale: The preprint formalizes repair benefit versus damage and reports a controlled N=500 GSM8K stress comparison: VRR-Stop 0.722 true validity versus fixed-five 0.116 at 0.72 average repairs, with paired significance and explicit damaging-repair measurements. It also exposes verifier-discrimination failure and a guarded fallback.
assessments.tested_scope: Binary plan-validity verify/repair model and tested GSM8K/model stress cells plus stated replications.
corrections_or_limits: The +2.2 pp versus no-repair cell is not confirmed because its CI crosses zero.
The stopping rule does not identify which historical checkpoint to rewind to.
Under review; no independent numerical replication identified.

assessments.rationale: The chronology-audit set is unusually transparent: 82/240 to 88/240 with exact McNemar p=0.2632 and bootstrap CI crossing zero. The broader 467-pair gain is explicitly exploratory because threshold selection saw many IDs, and intervention controls change multiple components.
assessments.tested_scope: One 4-bit 1.5B reasoner on MATH-500 under the paper's retrospective chronology audit and exploratory historical-coverage set.
corrections_or_limits: Do not call the 240-pair result confirmed improvement.
Do not attribute the exploratory gain specifically to rollback-target selection.
The empirical detector is not a certified e-process/e-detector.

assessments.rationale: Controlled invalidation keeps task/payload shape while breaking authority before durability: 262/270 endpoints succeed but only 55/270 are authorized and 207 invalidating rows commit after authority failure. Matched/negative controls and CommitGuard mitigation directly test the boundary mechanism.
assessments.tested_scope: Protected browser/tool/multi-agent commit surfaces that emit witness/dependency/binding/eligibility evidence and support atomic final check-and-commit.
corrections_or_limits: Hidden dependencies, bypass side effects and forged evidence remain outside scope.
Safe mitigation can trade visible success for conservative aborts.

assessments.rationale: PACE combines a per-candidate anytime-valid paired acceptance gate with direct repeated self-evolution experiments. The primary abstract corroborates 30-42% false and 10-33% harmful greedy edits, 13-21 spurious edits when no gain exists, a 4.9-point degradation in the fragile cell, and ~18% lower evaluation cost for PACE.
assessments.tested_scope: Prompt-level self-evolution on Qwen2.5 0.5B-3B across GSM8K, SVAMP and ARC-Challenge under the paper's paired testing interface.
corrections_or_limits: Guarantee is per decision, not a familywise/global guarantee across all adaptive archive writes.
Does not cover stable systematic evaluator bias or full population/QD archives.
No independent replication identified.

assessments.rationale: Primary study directly separates semantic proposal from deterministic credit and reports sealed-test gains plus an explicit neutral-mechanism false-credit experiment; this is strong evidence that single-run mean-improvement gates can manufacture phantom wins.
assessments.tested_scope: GSME's tested harness-evolution domains and deterministic/paired gate configuration with sealed final test.
corrections_or_limits: The ~60% phantom-win result is evaluation noise in this harness, not an injected judge-flip sweep.
Cross-cell winners show mechanism engagement, not a matched proof that QD causes endpoint gains.

assessments.rationale: Loreley provides a matched 7-block x 48-job comparison with public machine-readable evidence. QD is -0.135% versus Sequential Champion with BCa interval crossing zero and +0.320% versus Independent Root, so endpoint superiority is not established even though stepping-stone ancestry is visibly engaged.
assessments.tested_scope: Zstandard throughput on the specified ARM64 evaluator with equal physical candidate-job budget and native policy concurrency.
corrections_or_limits: Equal candidate jobs do not guarantee equal wall-clock/token use.
Mechanism engagement is not causal benefit.
Public replay scaffold is feasibility evidence until corruption replay is actually run.

assessments.rationale: The official author code is source-qualified and the sealed worker identifies a direct metric mismatch: paper Eq.15 uses absolute Hamming error while Model_comparison.py omits abs(), permitting cancellation of opposite bit errors. This strongly blocks numerical Figure-4 verification from the current code.
assessments.tested_scope: The public official Model_comparison.py benchmark implementation and its claimed Figure-4 retrieval comparison; analytical fixed-point/convergence results are separate.
corrections_or_limits: Do not infer the published figure was necessarily generated from the current buggy file without provenance.
No fixed seed/raw matrices are released, so exact stochastic cells are unrecoverable from the repository alone.
This finding does not invalidate the paper's analytical results.

assessments.rationale: The paper's memory-disabled w/o-CBR arm rises 78.65 to 84.47 across iterations, while the paper-era public runtime lacks the five-iteration experiment operator. Therefore the common upward slope cannot be identified as memory-specific continual learning from public artifacts.
assessments.tested_scope: Memento Table 4 and the last public repository state before paper-v2, limited to what those artifacts specify.
corrections_or_limits: This is an ablation/auditability gap, not evidence that Table-4 values are false.
Later retriever code must not be retroactively assumed to implement the paper-era protocol.

assessments.rationale: Source-matched primary verification supports the distinction between evidence validity and mutation authority: stage completion validates evidence, but caller identity/early-completion authority remains free-text/boolean rather than an opaque capability; the repository documents a prior run-13 incident.
assessments.tested_scope: Inspected Argus stage-machine/sandbox implementation at the pinned public commit and documented historical incident.
corrections_or_limits: No live unauthorized mutation was reproduced in this wave.
Filesystem integrity containment is not equivalent to capability revocation.
Need a direct Engineer-subprocess regression before escalating beyond source-level reachability.

assessments.rationale: BFS-Prover-V2 reports 95.08% MiniF2F with planner and strong qualitative evidence for ordered focused subgoals/dynamic replanning, but the planner comparison changes multiple components and compute; the 7,200-vs-800 case is a single theorem.
assessments.tested_scope: Formal theorem proving with BFS-Prover-V2's planner-enhanced multi-agent architecture.
corrections_or_limits: Do not attribute the 86.1->95.08 delta solely to replanning or focused parallelism.
No compute-matched scheduler ablation or calibrated replan trigger is reported.

assessments.rationale: Primary ICLR-2026/arXiv evidence corroborates 87% MiniF2F, 57% PutnamBench and 49% Seed-Prover proof-length compression, with Lean-verified correctness and execution-speed profiling. The worker correctly separates completed-proof simplification from online search-state compression.
assessments.tested_scope: Verified Lean proof simplification and reuse on the paper's benchmark/prover artifacts.
corrections_or_limits: Token length is not a sufficient execution-cost proxy; some shorter proofs run slower.
The ~2% downstream SFT gain is preliminary/same-family and should not be generalized.
Net compute benefit depends on reuse frequency and simplification cost.

assessments.rationale: R&D-Agent directly ablates sample-based iterative debugging under the 12-hour MLE-Bench setting: the representative full-system trajectory reaches 34.7% Any Medal while full-dataset debugging reaches 24.0%. The mechanism is concrete and implementation-backed, but the development ablation is one representative run.
assessments.tested_scope: MLE-Bench autonomous data-science development under the paper's fixed 12-hour budget and representative temporal ablation.
corrections_or_limits: Do not treat the 10.7-point gap as a multi-seed causal estimate.
Cheap-fidelity debugging validates implementation efficiency, not scientific sufficiency of subset results.

assessments.rationale: Scientific Taste uses very large field/time-matched community preference data and reports temporal-OOD/unseen-field/review/attention transfer plus policy optimization. This is strong evidence for community-impact preference prediction and proposal triage, not for truth or experimental validity.
assessments.tested_scope: Scientific-paper impact/community-preference modeling and idea-ranking under the paper's citation/review/Altmetric-derived targets.
corrections_or_limits: Generated ideas were not prospectively experimentally validated.
Citation/community attention is a biased proxy and must not become a validity gate.
No independent validation of realized scientific impact identified.

assessments.rationale: The primary study spans 25 agent-method configurations over 525 tasks/25 episodes, separates unsafe authoring, retrieval and fresh-session execution, and evaluates a wrapper with write-time repair plus reuse-time retirement. Aggregate and component results directly support lifecycle governance rather than one-shot patch gating.
assessments.tested_scope: SkillMisevo targeted malicious-exposure/carryover benchmark and the tested AutoSkill/EvoSkill/OpenClaw SafeEvolve configurations.
corrections_or_limits: Do not generalize malicious-exposure risk to arbitrary benign self-improvement.
OpenClaw cells show material utility loss, so safety governance is not uniformly free.
Thresholds/capacity values are tested settings, not universal constants.
No independent replication identified.

source_boundary_updates.note: Released driver/perturbation definitions support assay reconstruction, but run/data outputs are excluded from the public repository; published 14/16 remains primary-study evidence rather than an independently inspectable per-case archive.

material_high_strength: DriftLens exact same-label visual-shift code substrate with a directly inspectable wrapper defect and clear window-vs-sequential scope.
Finite-sample causal-invariance target-safe aggregation with explicit target-only fallback envelope and matching lower bounds.
HASTE hard-negative potency and shifted-category regressions under direct peer-reviewed table evidence.
VRR-Stop repair-benefit-versus-damage stopping with large controlled stress delta and verifier-discrimination failure mode.
Commit-time authorization controlled invalidation separating endpoint success from authorized durable effects.
PACE repeated false-commit control, GSME false-credit gating, and Loreley matched-budget negative endpoint control.
Official astrocyte-gated code/paper Hamming-metric mismatch requiring corrected rerun before Figure-4 quantitative use.
ProofOptimizer Lean-verified proof compression and execution profiling.
SafeEvolve longitudinal write/retrieval/execution governance with retirement component evidence.
material_holds_or_scope_corrections: LargeMonitor exact alarm/reset/policy reproduction remains incomplete because numeric kappa_h and runnable alarm-stage code are still missing.
DriftLens standard use-case accuracy is independent-window classification, not a chronological alarm trace; do not derive FAR/delay/NDT.
Adapto threshold-9 mitigation claims are bundle-dependent; final_confirmation and LOFO artifacts must not be collapsed.
MGT-B chronology-audit direction is positive but non-confirmatory and its rollback-target selector is component-confounded.
BFS-Prover-V2 86.1->95.08 planner headline is not a compute-matched replanning/focused-scheduler ablation.
R&D-Agent two-fidelity development effect is from one representative temporal ablation run, not a multi-seed causal estimate.
Scientific Taste predicts community-impact preference, not scientific truth or experimentally realized value.
Memento's no-CBR iteration slope remains operator-unidentified, so the common iteration rise is not memory-specific evidence.

exact_next_action: Hold this exact wave identity until Integrator consumes matching novelty+relevance and evidence outputs. For evidence follow-up, prioritize a corrected fixed-seed rerun of the official astrocyte-gated Model_comparison metric, reconstruct Adapto threshold-9 bundle provenance, seek independent/multi-architecture HASTE replication, and derive/simulate the 10-50-task McNemar e-process power/discordance behavior. Do not substitute newer worker artifacts into this sealed wave.
